reviews.title: Built in Bloat
reviews.text:
You have to ask what the point of having an ad-blocking web browser is when the web browser itself constantly disrupts the experience with full page pop-ups for features the browser itself is advertising like their dodgy VPN and ridiculous crypto features. 

Ultimately it does not pass the test of being able to install this on a family members device as they would be utterly bewildered with the full screen pop-ups for useless features like the crypto rewards nonsense which absolutely has the look and feel of some kind of scam.

Whilst the built-in ad-blocking features are powerful, overall this is outweighed by all the built-in bloatware. Some aspects of the interface also look quite outdated.

reviews.title: AI is under trained
reviews.text:
The results the AI serves from search page, provides misinformation and non related search results due to being unable to differentiate between site content fields as defined by website providers (which is sadly often not very well applied as per W3C’ basic standards for content publishers), this is resulting in unreliable results, which often make no sense. The words might make a sentence but they don’t relate to a useful or informative result.
At this rate, it may be years before usable results are issued from a search, sadly, it’s just not any good at what it’s provided to do and requires an in depth review from Brave teams related to its provision (ideally before its release into service).

reviews.title: Great, but missing vital restore function.
reviews.text:
This is fantastic for most things, but there’s one really major issue here. 
Where’s the “restore previous session” function? This app is really prone to random crashes, and there’s no way to easily restore the previously open tabs. This is a major omission, and makes the browser unreliable.
How is something so basic missing from an otherwise-excellent app?
I have particular tabs open for a reason, and it’s often impossible to get everything back, as the history is also unreliable. 
This is incredibly frustrating, and I’m now looking for an alternative because of this issue. There’s no way I would ever consider paying for something that’s missing such a basic aspect of operation.
